# Unlocking Lenses

## Introduction[​**](#introduction "Copy to clipboard")

If you see a Snapcode with a circle in the center, that means it can unlock a Lens. You can even share these Lenses with friends so they can use them, too!

## Unlocking Lenses[​**](#unlocking-lenses-1 "Copy to clipboard")

### Scan & Unlock a Lens[​**](#scan-and-unlock-a-lens "Copy to clipboard")

If you see a Snapcode with a circle in the center, scan it! It might have a special Lens inside you can use for a limited time.

To scan a Snapcode, point Snapchat's camera at the code. Snapchat will automatically look for Snapcodes and show you a notification when it finds one.

You should not have any Lens activated in order for Snapchat to look for Snapcodes.

### Opening a Lens Link[​**](#opening-a-lens-link "Copy to clipboard")

Lenses can also be shared via URL.

**To unlock a Lens from a Lens Link...**

1. Click the link!
2. If you're on your mobile device, Snapchat will automatically open.
3. If you're on a non-mobile device, you'll be taken to a webpage displaying the Snapcode.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Some Lenses are viewable on the web as well!

### Unlock a Lens You See in a Snap[​**](#unlock-a-lens-you-see-in-a-snap "Copy to clipboard")

If you see a fun-looking Lens in a friend's Snap or somewhere else on Snapchat, you might be able unlock it yourself!

**To unlock a Lens from a Snap…**

1. **Swipe up** on the Snap to view Context Cards
2. **If there’s a card with the Lens on it, tap it** to try it out!

### Sharing a Lens with a Friend[​**](#sharing-a-lens-with-a-friend "Copy to clipboard")

**To share a Lens you’ve unlocked with a friend…**

1. Open the Lens you want to share.

2. **Tap the share button** in the top-left the Lens button to copy the Lens link, as well as bring up the sharing panel.
